name: brain-starter
description: A skill that turns task resistance into one real start.

interface.shortDescription: Turn resistance into one real start
interface.longDescription: Find the friction blocking a real task, use the lowest effective AI intervention, preserve user judgment and growth, and turn intention into one observable ten-minute start.
defaultPrompt: I know what I need to do, but I cannot start.
My head is crowded. Help me choose what to begin now.
Give me a short attention refuel, then move me into the real task.
